citation: Cimmino and contributors. pygfunction: a g-function calculator for Python. https://github.com/MassimoCimmino/pygfunction
description: pygfunction is Massimo Cimmino and contributors' Python model for calculating thermal response factors of geothermal borefields. It uses an analytical finite-line-source solution to represent thermal interference among boreholes, including arbitrary positions and differing lengths or radii. Inputs define borehole geometry, ground thermal diffusivity and requested times; outputs are g-functions and, with load aggregation and pipe models, borehole or fluid temperatures. Spatial coverage is the configured field. Temporal resolution is user-selected, with an example calculating hourly values for one day in a hundred-borehole field. Free BSD-3-Clause source is available through GitHub and PyPI with examples and dependency requirements. A limitation is that the selected analytical assumptions and thermal parameters require site-specific checking. The model can support geothermal heat-pump sizing and building-energy simulations. No direct relationship to another catalogue record was established beyond the shared energy-system scope of PyPSA (model-pypsa). No simulation was run.
inputs: Borehole geometry and ground thermal properties
